name: The Clayton Brothers

tenures.source: the fed's ReVolution #001 results page (17 August 2008): the two-man side Nathan Paradine was booked against in the opening handicap match, who never arrived.

caption: The team Nathan Paradine was booked against in the opening handicap match of ReVolution #001, who did not show; the owner announced they would not be heard from again, and the show's video cut to a burning car.
